First, note the given date: 08-31-1384 (August 31, 1384).  
Subtract 51 weeks and 1 day = 51 × 7 + 1 = 358 days.  

1384 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply even though Gregorian calendar wasn't adopted until 1582, but we follow the rule given).  
August 31 is day 244 of the year in leap year (Jan 31 = 31, Feb 29 = 60, Mar 31 = 91, Apr 30 = 121, May 31 = 152, Jun 30 = 182, Jul 31 = 213, Aug 31 = 244).  

244 − 358 = −114 days, so go back into previous year 1383.  
1383 is not leap (not divisible by 4), so it has 365 days.  
365 − 114 = 251 days into 1383.  

Day 251 in non-leap year:  
Jan 31 = 31, Feb 28 = 59, Mar 31 = 90, Apr 30 = 120, May 31 = 151, Jun 30 = 181, Jul 31 = 212, Aug 31 = 243.  
251 − 243 = 8 → September 8, 1383.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1383-09-08
